title: The Plough: Dubhe
subtitle: sixteen pixels, the icon corner to corner
description: The first star of the Plough, and both ends of the node's small
range at once: 16 pixels across -- the smallest a node goes -- with
the icon at `iconScale: 1.0`, corner to corner. A big node with a
small icon is a picture with room around it; a small node with a
The shape is `none`, so the node draws no panel at all: the icon is
the node, and the whole square is clickable.
It is also hidden: `hideUntilDependenciesVisible` keeps it off the
canvas until the comet -- its one dependency -- is itself visible,
and the six stars after it chain the same flag, so the Plough
reveals itself one link at a time. That recursion is the one rule
in the visibility family that cannot be read off a single file.
